paper.title: Enhancing Neural-Network Variational Monte Carlo through Basis Transformation
paper.authors: Zhixuan Liu, Dongheng Qian, Jing Wang

results.system_description: 3D homogeneous electron gas, N = 14 (7 up, 7 down), r_s = 1, simple cubic cell, Gamma point
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational Monte Carlo energy of the neural-network wave function (FermiNet n_det=1, E' (no basis transf.)) at this N, r_s and cell, without finite-size correction or twist averaging.
results.notes: As printed (total energy per simulation cell, in Hartree). Madelung term: Ewald, "+ b.g." neutralizing background; N=14 values/14 agree with Pescia/Wilson to ~1e-4 relative -> same convention (Madelung included). Boundary: periodic; twist not mentioned (Gamma presumed).
